meta.seasonalMethod: seasonally adjusted by whatchanged (county pattern blended with the state pattern based on history length)
meta.seasonalDetail: log seasonal factors = w * own + (1 - w) * state pool, w = n / (n + 8), n = fewest leak-free ratios (ratio months <= 2024-06) in any calendar month; pools from series with >= 6 ratios per month; saPool = pool used, saW = w
meta.levels: baseRent/curRent are observed (not seasonally adjusted) typical asking rents, $/mo
meta.dollarChange: monthly change consistent with pct = curRent - curRent / (1 + pct/100)
